A_ACTxDESI_bandpower_covariance.evidence: 171 stored 12x12 blocks == exactly the upper triangle of 18 spectra (18*19/2 = 171). Assembled to a complete 216x216 matrix with ZERO missing blocks. Symmetric to max|C-C^T|/max|C| = 2.30e-17. Positive definite (min eig 1.00e-17 > 0, cond 2.21e6). Cross-spectrum correlation is non-trivial: median |rho| = 0.0716, max |rho| = 0.4841, 88.2 per cent of cross-blocks exceed |rho| > 0.01.
A_ACTxDESI_bandpower_covariance.storage_convention: cov_X_Y_M_N = Cov(C^{XY}, C^{MN}); upper triangle over the 18 spectra only; transpose for the lower half. NOT diagonal-only, NOT lower-triangle-only.
A_ACTxDESI_bandpower_covariance.spectra: 18 = 6 (PR4 x gal) + 6 (DR6 x gal) + 6 (gal auto); 12 bandpowers each; gal = BGSz1, BGSz2, LRGz1..LRGz4

B_DESI_DR1_compressed_ShapeFit_covarianc.evidence: Published as SIX independent per-bin 4x4 covariances. arXiv:2411.12021 states verbatim: 'We consider each redshift bin independent'. Printed in the paper as UPPER TRIANGLE ONLY ('-' in the lower half); lower half verified empty before symmetrising. All 12 matrices positive definite after symmetrisation.
B_DESI_DR1_compressed_ShapeFit_covarianc.warning: A diagonal/per-bin-only product. If T5's statistic needs DESI cross-redshift-bin covariance, it is NOT in this product and must come from the (currently offline) DR1 full-shape likelihood HDF5 files.

findings.asymmetry_warning: All 16 arrays are stored SLIGHTLY NON-SYMMETRIC (max|C-C^T|/max|C| between 3.6e-5 and 3.8e-4) — they are chain-estimated, not analytically symmetrised. Symmetrise before inverting. All are positive definite after symmetrisation.
